title: Nicki Minaj Says Lil Baby Murdered ‘Do We Have A Problem?’ They Also Have Another Record Coming
htmlContent:
In a recent interview with Shay Diddy of 106 Mel, Nicki Minaj dropped two singles with Lil Baby. The first single will be released on February 4th.

"Lil Baby murdered this record. He came so hard... Pause. We did two songs actually, and I might let people hear a little piece of it when this record comes out on February 4th," said Minji

"You never know it might be a surprise, but we are putting out the video. As of now as long everything goes as planned I will put the visual out on February 4th. When the visual comes out you might get a taste of the other song and the fans will be able to decide which one is the better Nicki and [Lil] Baby song."

She added, "I'm always going to be that girl you know the bad guy, Chung Lee. So, you know, it is what it is. I'm always going to say what I gotta to say because that's when I supposed to talk."

Speaking of Nicki Minaj, she recently congregated Rihanna and ASAP Rocky on the news that the Umbrella singer was pregnant.

“So happy for you mama,” Nicki wrote in a since-deleted Instagram post, per HotNewHipHop. “Conquered the world already. Given so much. Nothing left to prove. you deserve your own little gift now. Different level of joy that money can’t buy.”

Make sure to checkout “Do We Have a Problem? dropping February 4th.
